build_cpp_ast: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and Generate to parse classes, functions, and methods
create_ast_builder: create an AstBuilder from a token stream to parse C++ source with namespace and class context
parse_cpp_tokens: parse C++ tokens into AST nodes like Class, Function, Method, and VariableDeclaration using the AstBuilder
convert_types: convert C++ type tokens into Type objects with template support using TypeConverter.ToType
extract_parameters: extract function parameters from C++ tokens into Parameter objects using TypeConverter.ToParameters
